title.narrative: Enhancing and sustaining access to safe water, sanitation, hygiene practices for women, men, girls, boys in drought-affected people of Lasqoray .

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aims to deliver emergency life-saving WASH services to 11,190nbspvulnerable individuals, including 3,250 women, 3,015 girls, 1,912 men, 3,013 boys, and persons with disabilities (PWDs), particularly in Lasqoray rural communities and among drought-displaced populations, elderly, and those with disabilities.nbspTo address the ongoing drought crisis, the project will establish a new shallow well in Durduri 10 to 20 meters deep andnbsprehabilitate an existing borehole innbspUlxeednbspequipping itnbspwith solar-powered systemnbspto ensure reliable access to sufficient water. Works will include community kiosks and animal troughs. The existingnbspelevated water tank servingnbspCeelaayo borehole will undergo comprehensive rehabilitation to restore its functionality.nbspIn Buran village, water access will be improved by replacing thenbspsubmersible pump, raising pipes, cables andnbspover 1,500 meters of old pipes.nbspnbspHabarshiro, Kaladhacda, Sibaaayo, Balibusle, Caadsaran villages and Dhanaha IDP campnbspwill receive emergency water trucking services delivering 2,400, 000 liters over three months to support pastoralist communities in surrounding areas tonbspmeet urgent water needs.nbspTo ensure the sustainability of water infrastructure, a budget for operations andnbspmaintenance contingencies will be allocated, coupled with regular monitoring to assess facility performance and water quality. The project also emphasizes capacity buildingnbsptraining 30 local operators and community members in management and maintenance practices, as well as providing technical training for 50 community members and WASH personnel.nbsp16,000 Aqua Tabs will be distributed throughnbsppublic institutions including schools, MCH facilities to promote access to potable water for 4,000 HHs. Feedback mechanisms will be established to enhance transparency and enable continuous improvement of WASH services across all target locations. TASS will empower community members through awareness on protection sanitation and hygiene promotion meetings and distribution of IEC materials and billboards with context related and locally accepted messages to promote gender equality, PSEA prevention, and sanitation hygiene practices. ltbrgtlt/pgt
